audit.whatIsWrong: Every prose field says Darius dominates lane ('Total Darius dominance', whys 1-6 all Darius), but the level chart hands levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items to Vayne and the matchup is graded HARD 8/10 in red.
audit.why: Vayne has no early trading power; the packet levelChart is Darius x6 with Vayne only at two items, and the 50.66% Emerald+ win rate does not support an 8/10 difficulty.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Darius for Level 1 through First item, Vayne at Two+ items; diff EVEN, 4.5/10, tone recoloured off the red HARD swatch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes listed as 'Vayne: Condemn online, level 6, first item' with no real numbers, and Final Hour is described only as 'stealth and AD'.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s; Final Hour is 100/85/70s and grants invisibility only during Tumble plus a reduced Tumble cooldown (already 6/5/4/3/2). Vayne's true spike is her second item, not Condemn coming online.
audit.corrected: Spike text keyed to Silver Bolts scaling and Condemn's 12-20s window; Final Hour described accurately.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is described as a flat 'wall-stun' with no statement of the terrain condition, and Silver Bolts' true damage is never connected to the recommended Plated Steelcaps.
audit.why: Riot's text: Condemn knocks the target back and only impales/stuns on collision with terrain — fought in open lane it is a knockback, not CC. Silver Bolts deals percent max-health TRUE damage on every third consecutive hit on the same target, so armour and Steelcaps do nothing against it and stacking health makes it hit harder. Both sides also carry displacement (Apprehend vs Condemn) — whoever lands it first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: Terrain condition on Condemn stated; Steelcaps advice qualified against true damage; the displacement race called out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends Plated Steelcaps without noting that Vayne's main damage is percent-max-health true damage.
audit.why: Steelcaps reduces auto-attack physical damage; Silver Bolts' third-hit damage is true and scales with your max health.
audit.corrected: Boots advice qualified; health stacking flagged as feeding Silver Bolts.

audit.why: Nothing in the kit file indicates a recent change to either champion; patch 26.15 is live and 26.16 is not.

edits.after: Fight her in open lane so Condemn is only a knockback, pull her off each last-hit step, and close before Silver Bolts scales.
edits.before: Camp lane bushes to drop aggro, bait her Condemn knockback, and pop Ghost instantly to run her down when her push tool is on cooldown.

edits.after: Pull to stick and kill her before she scales. Condemn only stuns into terrain — duel her away from walls.
edits.before: Pull to stick and kill her before she scales. Track Condemn before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.after: Vayne wins by pinning you to terrain with Condemn and reaching two items of Silver Bolts.
edits.before: Vayne wins by landing Condemn, denying your pattern, and kiting or out-trading your pull windows.

edits.after: Vayne tumbles around your Q slow, but Condemn only stuns if it slams you into terrain — hold the open lane and it is a 550-range shove. E-pull, outer-Q, and bleed her out before she scales.
edits.before: Vayne tumbles around your Q slow and condemns you into walls. E-pull is your only stick — land it, outer-Q, and burst her before she scales. She wins if she kites. Don't chase past the wave into Condemn.

edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: 20/18/16/14/12s, matchup-defining — it only stuns on terrain collision, so stand off the walls and it is just a knockback. Bait it, then pull; Apprehend and Condemn are a race, and whoever lands first owns the trade. Vayne Tumble: 6/5/4/3/2s, an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell. Darius Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — never throw it predictably; spend it on her tumble recovery.
edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Position so she can’t pin you. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.

edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 4.5/10, Vayne carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Vayne carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.after: Vayne: Condemn ranks (20s to 12s), Final Hour at 6, and above all her second item. Darius: level 2-3, first item, 2-item window.
edits.before: Vayne: Condemn online, level 6, first item. Darius: level 2-3 (full trade kit), first item spike, and the 2-item side-lane window.

edits.after: Only stuns into terrain. Duel in open lane and it is a shove. Its 12-20s cooldown is your go.
edits.before: Wall-stun. Position so she can’t pin you. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.

edits.after: Never brawl with a wall at your back — terrain collision is the only thing that turns Condemn into a stun.
edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.after: Track Condemn, 12-20s: it only stuns on terrain. Fight in open lane and pull while it is down.
edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Position so she can’t pin you. Engage only while it is down.

edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Stridebreaker, then Sterak's Gage. Steelcaps does nothing to Silver Bolts' true damage, and raw health only feeds it.
edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Stridebreaker (the stickiness fix), then Sterak's Gage / Dead Man's Plate; boots Plated Steelcaps.

edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 4.5/10, Vayne carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Vayne carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.after: With a first item (often Kraken or BORK) her W Silver Bolts starts shredding you: every third consecutive hit on you is percent max-health true damage, so armour and Steelcaps do nothing. Respect that she can kite a missed E-pull now.
edits.before: With a first item (often Kraken or BORK) her W Silver Bolts true-damage every third hit starts shredding your health bar and her Q tumble resets her spacing. Respect that she can now kite a missed E-pull — don't chase past your range.

edits.after: Vayne flips the matchup once items land: Silver Bolts' percent max-health true damage punishes a tanky Darius harder, not less, and Condemn plus tumble kite your short range. Only commit R when you can instantly stick, and frontline instead of solo-chasing her.
edits.before: Vayne flips the matchup once items land: Silver Bolts true damage shreds tanky Darius, and Condemn plus tumble kite your short range. Only commit R when you can instantly stick to her, and prefer to frontline for your team rather than solo-chasing a fed Vayne.

edits.after: You stay firmly ahead through 6. Final Hour only hides her during Tumble and speeds that reset up, so a landed E-pull into W-slow still means she cannot escape. Zone her off CS, force her under tower, and snowball before Silver Bolts scales.
edits.before: You stay firmly ahead through 6. Even with R Final Hour's stealth and AD, a landed E-pull into W-slow means she can't escape your all-in. Zone her off CS, force her under tower, and snowball — her Silver Bolts haven't come online to punish you yet.
